env_secret.title: {0} {1} has a secret written in the Dockerfile
env_secret.why: it is stored in the image, for anyone who can pull it
env_secret.fix: remove the value: the app gets it at run time from env_file: .env; a secret the build needs goes in with RUN --mount=type=secret

root.title: The image runs as root
root.why: if someone breaks into the app, they are root in the container
root.fix: end this stage with a USER line for an unprivileged user, for example USER www-data

copy_all.title: {0} copies the whole folder and there is no .dockerignore
copy_all.why: the image gets .env, .git and forge-work/ too
copy_all.fix: add a .dockerignore that lists .env, .git and forge-work/

ignore.title: {1} does not keep out {0}
ignore.why: a COPY of the folder puts it in the image, for anyone who has the image to read
ignore.fix: add a line {0} at the end of {1}

missing.title: The image build needs {1}, which is not in the project folder
missing.why: docker compose build stops at this {0} line, so the app cannot be built or started
missing.fix: add {1}, or correct the path; a file made during the build comes from a build stage (COPY --from=)

kept_out.title: The image build needs {1}, which {2} keeps out
kept_out.why: docker compose build stops at this {0} line: the file never reaches the build
kept_out.fix: let it in with a line !{1} at the end of {2}, or copy another file

kept_secret.title: The image build copies {1}, a file of secrets that {2} keeps out
kept_secret.why: docker compose build stops at this {0} line, and letting the file in would put its secrets in the image, for anyone who has the image to read
kept_secret.fix: never let it in: take it out of this {0} line; the app reads its secrets at run time (env_file: .env in the compose file), and a secret the build needs goes in with RUN --mount=type=secret, never into a layer

tag.title: Base image {0} is not pinned to a version
tag.why: the image can change under you and break a build that worked
tag.fix: pin a version, at least major.minor, for example node:24-alpine

no_example.title: No .env.example
no_example.why: whoever runs the app cannot tell which settings it needs
no_example.fix: add .env.example with every name from .env and fake values

no_health.title: No healthcheck
no_health.why: nobody sees that the app is stuck, and depends_on cannot wait until it is ready
no_health.fix: add a healthcheck: to the app service that requests its health URL
